meta.parties: In Re the Estate of P.H. Nicholas Holsinger v. Nicholas

rules.statement: An executor's remuneration should be a rate rather than a lump sum, and it should bear some relation to the magnitude of the estate.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think it is quite reasonable that the executor's remuneration should bear some relation to the magnitude of the estate. That, I think, was the intention of the Legislature, and it is quite reasonable that, where the estate is a large one, the executor should be remunerated more fully than in the case of a small estate, even though the work involved may be much the same in the two cases."
